parameters.query:
SELECT rs.id AS score_id, rs.session_id, rs.persona_alignment_score, rs.reviewed_at,
       ra.confidence, ra.evidence, ra.suggested_fix_area
FROM review_scores rs
JOIN review_attributions ra ON ra.review_score_id = rs.id
WHERE ra.attribution_type = 'persona_text' AND rs.proposal_generated_at IS NULL
ORDER BY rs.reviewed_at DESC
